ai_runs_task_subject_match.name: ai_runs_task_subject_match
ai_runs_task_subject_match.value:
(
        "ai_runs"."task_type" in ('profile_extract', 'positioning_report')
        and "ai_runs"."positioning_session_id" is not null
        and "ai_runs"."creation_project_id" is null
        and "ai_runs"."review_id" is null
      ) or (
        "ai_runs"."task_type" = 'content_plan'
        and "ai_runs"."positioning_session_id" is null
        and "ai_runs"."creation_project_id" is not null
        and "ai_runs"."review_id" is null
      ) or (
        "ai_runs"."task_type" = 'review_report'
        and "ai_runs"."positioning_session_id" is null
        and "ai_runs"."creation_project_id" is null
        and "ai_runs"."review_id" is not null
      )

content_plans_provenance_required.name: content_plans_provenance_required
content_plans_provenance_required.value: ("content_plans"."generation_mode" = 'ai' and "content_plans"."ai_run_id" is not null and "content_plans"."model" is not null and "content_plans"."prompt_version_id" is not null and "content_plans"."retrieval_record_id" is not null) or ("content_plans"."generation_mode" = 'manual' and "content_plans"."parent_version" is not null)

review_reports_provenance_required.name: review_reports_provenance_required
